- [Surgical and device therapies (5 concept packs, 94 facts in llms-facts.txt)](surgical-and-device-therapies/llms.txt): deep brain stimulation, adaptive DBS, focused ultrasound, levodopa pumps and infusions, and neuromodulation for gait

- [Neurobiology and disease landscape (8 concept packs, 57 facts in llms-facts.txt)](neurobiology-and-landscape/llms.txt): dopamine circuits, alpha-synuclein spread, neurodegeneration mechanisms, atypical parkinsonism, Lewy body dementia and age, sex and ancestry differences
- [Diagnosis and biomarkers (8 concept packs, 107 facts in llms-facts.txt)](diagnosis-and-biomarkers/llms.txt): clinical criteria, prodromal stage, staging, genetics, alpha-synuclein seed amplification, imaging, epidemiology and rating scales
- [Frontier platforms (6 concept packs, 28 facts in llms-facts.txt)](frontier-platforms/llms.txt): dopaminergic cell replacement, gene therapy, digital biomarkers and wearables, AI, the gut-brain axis with body-first versus brain-first subtypes, and precision medicine
